set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test ! -e deploy/state/startless-repeated-start-repairs-20261122/52.json || exit 61
tmp="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-startless-last.XXXXXXXX.py)"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
chmod 600 "$tmp"
curl -fLsS --max-time 25 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot/9655437b10ecb9063ee596d3901fdb1e8244136e/scripts/repair_repeated_start_existing_posts.py' > "$tmp"
test -s "$tmp" || exit 62
python3 "$tmp" --mode dry-run --topic-id 52 || exit 63
python3 "$tmp" --mode apply --topic-id 52 || exit 64
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 65
echo TENTH_ORIGINAL_MESSAGE_STARTLESS_VERIFIED=PASS
